|notes=The [[Insignificant Rebellion (V) (Virtual Set 10: Fourth Anthology) (Original 2005)|2005 original wording]] survives in the recovered publisher sheet. The original deploys unconditionally and uses either named Objective as an on-table prerequisite for the listed benefits. The remaster requires Ralltiir Operations to deploy, cancels Ounee Ta, and drops the ongoing Objective condition for its remaining actions.
